title: Vector Microcredit Decay Pilot & Rerank Contract Prep
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: validate a configurable microcredit model for per-vector billing that decays unused batch credits over time, and prepare enterprise contract/QSA language that aligns legal terms with the pilot. We need to balance unit economics for high-volume rerank customers while preserving predictability for enterprise procurement. The pilot will test a tiered microcredit allocation (daily/weekly pool), an expiry/decay policy, and a QPS-adjusted per-vector price for reranking flows. Deliverables: experiment design, instrumentation, customer pilot list, contract amendment drafts, QSA checklist updates.
acceptance_criteria: Experiment design doc reviewed by finance and eng
Instrumentation emitting per-customer microcredit usage and decay events to billing dashboard
Three pilot customers identified and signed for pilot terms
Draft contract addendum and QSA answers added to enterprise intake
Run simulated economics model showing expected revenue delta <= 8% for top 10% customers under baseline assumptions
